subject: Level 2
text: After winning 7 fights, you will gain enough experience points to become a Level 2 warrior, which almost doubles your hit points.

evidence.quote:
Also, after getting in 7 fights, you will have enough experience points and become a 
level 2 warrior. This will almost double your hit-points, so you can stay out that much longer.

subject: Level 3
text: Upon reaching Level 3, you learn the Heal spell.

evidence.quote:
After getting to the 3rd 
level, your strategy should change a little. No that you have learned the Heal spell, you have 
no need for the inn!

subject: Man behind desk
text: The man behind the desk in Tantegel Castle refills your magic points for free.

evidence.quote:
You know that guy behind the desk in Tantegel Castle? He can refill your 
magic points - FOR FREE!!

subject: Leather Armor
text: Leather Armor is sold in Brecconary for 70-G, and the shopkeeper buys your clothes for 10-G.

evidence.quote:
Once you have 70-G, head in to Brecconary and get your Leather Armor. He will buy your
clothes for 10-G.

subject: Copper Sword
text: The Copper Sword costs 180-G.

evidence.quote:
Now, you will want to get the Copper Sword
(180-G) before actually going anywhere interesting.

subject: Level 4
text: Upon reaching Level 4, you learn the Hurt attack spell and your magic points triple.

evidence.quote:
Upon becoming level 4, you will learn the Hurt spell (this is an attack spell) and your
magic points will triple.

subject: Slimes
text: At Level 5, Slimes will begin running away from you.

evidence.quote:
The next thing that will happen will probably be your upgrade to Level 5. Now, you are 
quite powerful, and will notice that Slimes are now running from you.

subject: Ghosts
text: Ghosts are encountered in the forest directly north of the mountains north of Tantegel and the hills east of those.

evidence.quote:
Though you should still 
stay away from the bottom row of hills to the south, you can now enter the forest directly 
north of the mountains north of Tantegel, and the hills east of those (but stay away from the 
desert). Here you will encounter Ghosts, but they won't be too tough.

subject: Garinham
text: From Tantegel, head north until you hit water, then head west to reach Garinham.

evidence.quote: Head north, and once you hit water, go west.

subject: Magicians
text: Magicians frequently cast the Hurt spell on the way to Garinham.

evidence.quote:
You might meet some Magicians on the way, but 
they should be no problem. They might make you heal yourself though, because they love to use 
the Hurt spell.

subject: Dragon's Scale
text: Dragon's Scale can be bought at the Garinham item shop for 20-G and used.

evidence.quote: Go ahead and buy a Dragon's Scale(20-G) at the item shop and use it.

subject: Erdrick's Cave
text: Erdrick's Cave is situated in a patch of desert passed on the way to Garinham.

evidence.quote:
You
remember that little patch of desert with a cave in the middle you passed on the way to 
Garinham? It's time to go there now!

subject: Erdrick's Cave B1
text: In Erdrick's Cave B1, head down to the intersection, go east to the wall, up, continue east to the wall, down, and hug the eastern wall to reach the stairs down.

evidence.quote:
Head down to the intersection, and go east. Go as far 
as you can until you hit a wall, go up, then continue east. Next time you hit a wall, go down 
and hug the wall to the east, until you hit some stairs. Go down the stairs.

subject: Erdrick's Tablet
text: Following the wall directions on the second floor of Erdrick's Cave leads to an opening to the south, then south and east to a chest containing Erdrick's Tablet.

evidence.quote:
On the next floor, go in each direction I say until hitting a wall. Up, west, down, west,
up, west, up, west, up, east, up, west, up, east. Now, going east, there will be an opening in
the wall to the south; go through it. Then, go south, east, and--wait! A chest! Take it, and 
you will find Erdrick's Tablet.

subject: Erdrick's Cave
text: Erdrick's Cave is the only cave in the game with no enemies.

evidence.quote:
I 
would just like to say that this is the only
cave in the game with no enemies.

subject: Small Shield
text: A Small Shield costs 90-G.

evidence.quote:
You 
should get up to Level 7, get a Small Shield(90-G), and a Chain Mail(300-G) before leaving the 
continent.

subject: Chain Mail
text: Chain Mail costs 300-G.

evidence.quote:
You 
should get up to Level 7, get a Small Shield(90-G), and a Chain Mail(300-G) before leaving the 
continent.

subject: North-East Continent
text: Leaving Tantegel and heading north then east brings you to a river with a bridge leading across to the North-East Continent.

evidence.quote:
Leave Tantegel, and head north, then east. Eventually, you will hit a river, 
containing a bridge near the middle. Go across. Welcome to the North-East Continent!

subject: Kol
text: After crossing the first bridge, go east, then south across another bridge, head north past a small mountain range, and head northeast into a forest to reach the village of Kol.

evidence.quote:
After crossing the bridge, you should go east, then south, following the grassland. You 
will come to yet another bridge, and should cross it. You should head north now. After passing
a small mountain range, head north-east into a forest, and you will find the lovely village of 
Kol.

subject: Hand Axe
text: The Hand Axe from Garinham costs 560-G.

evidence.quote:
Well, you may remember 
the Hand Axe(560-G) from Garinham. It is time to buy this weapon now.

subject: Half Plate
text: Half Plate armor costs 1000-G.

evidence.quote:
You should also save up 
for a Half Plate(1000-G).

subject: Skeletons
text: Skeletons are well armored and hit hard, but you can put them to sleep with the Sleep spell to attack them.

evidence.quote:
This is for your own good, as Skeletons are armored well and hit hard. If you do get
in a fight with one, though, you should probably run. If you are feeling dangerous, you should
try putting them to sleep and attacking them.

subject: Kol Inn
text: Staying at the Kol Inn costs 20-G.

evidence.quote:
When your hit points and 
magic points get low, you can either head back to Tantegel (make sure you have enuogh hit 
points to make it alive) or use the Kol Inn(20-G).

subject: Staff of Rain
text: In a cave at the top of a peninsula west and north of Kol, a man will give you the Staff of Rain if you bring him the Silver Harp.

evidence.quote:
If you wish, you can head west from Kol, then north on a little peninsula. At the top of 
the peninsula, you will find a little cave. In the cave is a little guy that says if you bring 
him a Silver Harp, he will give you a Staff of Rain (which you will need at some point).

subject: Level 8
text: At Level 8, regular attacks deal 10 to 15 damage, and Slimes, Red Slimes, Drakees, Ghosts, and Magicians run from you.

evidence.quote:
The next thing that will happen is you will graduate 
to Level 8. Upon doing so, you are quite strong, and are having regular attacks from 10 to 15, 
and will have Slimes, Red Slimes, Drakees, Ghosts, and Magicians running from you.

subject: Rock Mountain Cave
text: From west of Tantegel, cross the bridge leading south to the South-West Continent, head south past the mountains, then east avoiding the swamp to find Rock Mountain Cave.

evidence.quote:
Head west of Tantegel to the bridge leading south. Cross it. Welcome to the
South-West Continent! However, we aren't going to stay long, just long enough to get something.
Head south until you pass some mountains. Then head east, avoiding the swamp. Eventually, you 
will come to a cave. Go in. Welcome to Rock Mountain Cave.

subject: Herb
text: In Rock Mountain Cave B1, light a torch, go up and follow the wall past the first stairway to find an herb.

evidence.quote:
Upon entering, light a 
torch, and go up. Follow this wall until you get to a stairway. Pass it. Continue following 
this wall, and you will find an herb.

subject: Rock Mountain Cave B1
text: Continuing past the herb along the wall leads to another stairway going down.

evidence.quote: Continue, and you will find another stairway. Go down.

subject: Chest
text: On B2 of Rock Mountain Cave, going east to an intersection, heading up, and following the wall to the west leads to two chests, one containing a torch.

evidence.quote:
Go
east until you get to an intersection, and go up. Follow the wall above you to the west, and 
you will find two chests, containing a torch and the Fighter's Ring, the reason we came here.

subject: Chest
text: On B2 of Rock Mountain Cave, following the wall to the west after going up at the intersection leads to a chest containing the Fighter's Ring.

evidence.quote:
Go
east until you get to an intersection, and go up. Follow the wall above you to the west, and 
you will find two chests, containing a torch and the Fighter's Ring, the reason we came here.

subject: Chest
text: Continuing along the wall on B2 of Rock Mountain Cave leads to a chest containing 129-G.

evidence.quote: Continue along the wall, and you will find 129-G, and then 15-G.

subject: Chest
text: Continuing further along the wall on B2 of Rock Mountain Cave reveals a chest with 15-G.

evidence.quote: Continue along the wall, and you will find 129-G, and then 15-G.

subject: Level 9
text: At Level 9, you learn the Radiant spell, which illuminates a radius of 3 instead of 1 and makes torches obsolete.

evidence.quote:
With this new level,
you will gain a new spell, Radiant, that will make Torches moot...Radiant also lights up to a radius of 3 instead of 1.

subject: Swamp Cave
text: Inside Swamp Cave, go down, east, down, east, down, west to reach a stairway leading up to the South Island.

evidence.quote:
In this cave, the Swamp Cave (imaginative, huh?), you needn't use Radiant just yet. Simply
follow the directions I give you, going as far as you can in the instructed direction until you
hear a bumping sound. Go down, east, down, east, down, west. You will come to a stairway, and
should go up. You are now at the South Island, home to Rimuldar, the key-town, and the famous
Goldman.
